page.layout: One page: digitiser's cover sheet (e-rara.ch), not a printed page of the book. Nothing to transcribe.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet from e-rara.ch, left out as page furniture: e-rara logo, platform descriptions in German, English, French and Italian, terms-of-use notices, Visual Library logo, shelf mark and persistent link. The book's own title, "De caritate annonae ac fame conciones tres" by Lavater, Ludwig (Tiguri, anno 1587), appears only in this cover sheet and is not a printed page of the book.
